# Complaints Process

I want to make a complaint, how do I do this?

We’re sorry to hear that you’re unhappy with us and have a complaint. Please contact us using one of the methods below so that we can put this right for you: 

Call: 0333 777 8247\

Email: Click here to complete an online form.

Write:  Next Online  
             20 Radar Road  
             Leicester  
             LE3 1UF

You’ll need to provide your full details and if you’re a online customer you will also need to include your date of birth. 

I have an existing complaint

If you’ve already spoken to someone about your complaint and they haven’t been able to resolve it, our Specialist Team can step in. Please contact them via one of the following: [...] Email: Click here to complete an online form.

Write:  Complaints  
             Next Online  
             20 Radar Road  
             Leicester  
             LE3 1UF

To speed things up, please kindly provide: 

 Your name
 The details about your complaint - eg store name, item number, and your account or order number

I have a Credit related Complaint (Financial Ombudsman Service)

If you have a complaint about our credit services, please see our Consumer Credit Complaints Process. In the unlikely event that you remain dissatisfied with our response to any complaint regarding a Next Credit Product or Service, you may be entitled to refer it to the Financial Ombudsman Service. [...] The Ombudsman will only consider your complaint if you have allowed us to resolve it first. It is also important to note that the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) does not investigate individual complaints. Therefore please contact us directly in the first instance. 

\For all charges contact your service provider

Brass Lights - Ordered on 19/08 to be delivered next day, never arrived. Was calling daily to chase these up for 5 days until was finally told they had been damaged in transit so were not going to be delivered. A replacement order was raised which I was supposed to receive on 24/08 however I got a text message later that day to say it had been delayed (no reason) and that I should expect delivery the next working day. No update since then. No lights. No refund. No compensation nothing. Just waiting on a refund which I will have to call again today to request wasting more of my time and causing undue stress. 

I was going to order my new sofa here but have just ordered it elsewhere as this Next has gone downhill massively and they have lost a customer in me after this.

Evaluating 31,856 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Consumers frequently praise the excellent product quality, the impressive range of fashionable clothing, and the friendly staff. Shoppers also appreciate the efficient click-and-collect system, noting that orders arrive at local branches very quickly and conveniently. Many buyers highlight how simple the ordering process is, making online shopping a seamless and time-saving activity. Some reviewers were not happy with unexpected courier delivery delays and the lack of proper tracking updates for returned packages.
